label.text: This build has no edge link. The Maximal and Enterprise packages have it.
The edge link starts with the HTTPS listener, and it is not running in this process.
This node is an edge node. Local nodes pair with it in Edge Clients.

This node is not paired with an edge node. An edge node is a small server in the cloud that gives this node a public presence. This node dials out to it and keeps one link open, so it needs no open port or fixed address.
Make a pairing code on the edge node, in System, Edge Clients, then pair with it here.

container.style: col-12 col-md-auto row items-center q-gutter-y-xs m-record-actions

link.confirmation: Unpair from ${edge.edgeName}? The link closes on both sides, and pairing again needs a new code.

label.text: ${lastError || 'This node stopped linking to the edge node.'}

This node stops when the edge node's link key no longer matches its pin, and the edge node refuses this node when it was revoked there. Unpair, make a new pairing code on the edge node, and pair again.
Of the link that carries this node's work up. Edge cluster below lists the link to each member.

default-field.title: Generation
default-field.tooltip: Goes up by one each time the link comes up

default-field.title: Link key fingerprint
default-field.tooltip: The SHA-256 of the edge node's link key, pinned at pairing; a renewed web certificate does not change it

label.text: The edge node is a cluster: this node links to each of its members at the address the members list, takes requests and items from each, and sends its own work up one link at a time. The list is kept in runtime/db/edge_members, so a restart finds a member when the one it paired with is gone.

default-field.title: Address
default-field.tooltip: The member's edge_link_url, else the address this node paired with

default-field.title: Host names
default-field.tooltip: The public names the edge node answers for this node

default-field.title: XMPP
default-field.tooltip: Outside XMPP clients through the edge node's tunnel ports

default-field.title: Calls
default-field.tooltip: Where new calls have their media: the edge node's media node, with its TURN for outside browsers

default-field.title: Phones
default-field.tooltip: This node's trunks register from the edge node's SIP engine, and outside phones register to its registrar

link.confirmation: Pause queue delivery? Items wait on both nodes until you resume it.
Send every replicated set to the edge node whole again?

label.text: Queue delivery is paused: items wait on both nodes until it resumes.
Items this node queued for the edge node, by kind. Each goes once, in order.
Nothing is waiting for the edge node.
Replicated sets: records the edge node answers from while this node is away.

default-field.title: Epoch
default-field.tooltip: Each full send starts a new one

default-field.title: Last batch
default-field.tooltip: The last batch the edge node acknowledged in this epoch

label.text: No replicated sets in this node's edge conf, or none since the link started.

link.confirmation: Drain this node? It finishes what it has, the edge node sends its work to the other members, and its health check answers 503, until you resume it.
This node is its cluster's only live member. Draining it takes its sites offline at the edge node and holds queue delivery there, and its health check answers 503, until you resume it. Drain it?

label.text: Every member of this node's cluster links to the edge node on its own, with the pairing's key, and the edge node balances work over the live ones. It admits a new member only when a linked one lists it as live here. Drain a member before stopping or upgrading it.

default-field.title: This node
default-field.tooltip: Its instance id: the instance_id property when set, else the one kept in runtime/db/instance_id

default-field.title: State on its links
default-field.tooltip: What this node tells the edge node: starting, live, draining or stopping. Only a live member gets new work

default-field.title: Pairing
default-field.tooltip: The id the edge node knows this cluster by (edge_node_pairing in the .env the members share)

default-field.title: Heartbeat
default-field.tooltip: How long ago its heartbeat was written to the shared database
